_meta.description: Announced, preview, or upcoming changes. Removed and promoted to matrix.json when GA. Official sources only.

upcoming.title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs
upcoming.detail: AWS introduced Lambda MicroVMs as a serverless compute primitive for isolated execution of user-supplied or AI-generated code, with VM-level isolation, near-instant launch and resume, state preservation, and Firecracker virtualization. Track for the Serverless Functions row because this may affect the AWS mapping boundary between Lambda functions, isolated sandboxes, and AI code execution environments.

upcoming.title: AWS Transform - FSx for NetApp ONTAP migration preview
upcoming.detail: AWS announced a public preview storage-migration capability in AWS Transform for migrating block storage workloads from on-premises or cloud sources to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, in addition to Amazon EBS. Track because the matrix currently maps AWS migration primarily through AWS Application Migration Service, and this preview may affect the cloud-migration tooling row when it reaches GA.

upcoming.title: Azure legacy Blob and GPv1 storage account retirement
upcoming.detail: Microsoft documents retirement of legacy Blob storage account types and General Purpose v1 storage accounts, with new legacy account creation disabled in September 2026 and full retirement or auto-migration to GPv2 in October 2026. Track because the matrix maps Azure object storage as Azure Blob Storage, and older account types may require migration planning; this does not change Azure Blob Storage GA status.

upcoming.title: AWS FinOps Agent preview
upcoming.detail: AWS announced a preview FinOps Agent for AI-assisted cost questions, reporting, optimization recommendations, anomaly investigation, and scheduled FinOps workflows. Preview availability is US East (N. Virginia) and excludes AWS GovCloud (US) and AWS China Regions.

upcoming.title: Amazon Bedrock GovCloud — expanding to DoD IL4/IL5
upcoming.detail: AWS has indicated Bedrock in GovCloud will expand to DoD IL4/IL5 coverage. Currently FedRAMP Moderate baseline with limited model availability.

upcoming.title: Azure OpenAI Government — o3/o4 model availability
upcoming.detail: Azure OpenAI Government currently offers GPT-4 and GPT-4o. Newer models (o3, o4-mini) expected to follow with typical 3–6 month lag behind commercial availability.

upcoming.title: Google Cloud Malaysia region (Kuala Lumpur)
upcoming.detail: Google Cloud announced a new region in Malaysia. Expands Southeast Asia presence alongside Singapore.

upcoming.title: Microsoft Fabric — Government region availability
upcoming.detail: Microsoft's Azure Government roadmap lists Microsoft Fabric as Forecasted across Azure Government environments. Track this platform-level shift because the matrix maps Azure analytics as Azure Synapse Analytics / Microsoft Fabric. Do not track the narrower Synapse Link for Cosmos DB retirement here because Synapse Link is not a directly mapped capability.

upcoming.title: AWS CodeCommit — no new customers (July 2024)
upcoming.detail: AWS announced CodeCommit is no longer accepting new customers as of July 25, 2024. Existing customers retain access. AWS recommends migrating to GitHub, GitLab, or other SCM providers.
